limits: Qualification limited to the frozen cases; no general productivity gain measured.
Model and reasoning effort use configured defaults; exact values unavailable in the observed native events.
Selection and complete tool-mediated loading are instrumented; no automatic body injection claim.
Catalogue reconstruction occurs after execution; it is not a capture of the transmitted request. Each candidate is evaluated separately with the existing personal catalogue.
No application build, application test, database, provider collection, scanner or CI pipeline is established by these evaluations.

WR-H01 reproduces a controlled PowerShell7 argument capture, not Java application startup. WR-N01 exercises only a synthetic Java source probe under Windows PowerShell5.1; broader launcher/runtime reliability is not measured.
